subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or should it also change Telegram DMs away from the documented main-session default?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing Telegram default DM routing would alter documented compatibility behavior for existing users who rely on main-session continuity.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Rework or adopt the heartbeat wake fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting upgrade, docs, and migration impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat entries
options.body: Wait for native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Rework or adopt the heartbeat wake fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent cross-surface history across heartbeat, routing, and compatibility-sensitive session behavior.
